# CarouselBay Implementation Tasks & Design Notes

- **Source**: ColorLib carousel-17 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-17/`)
- **New Name**: `carouselbay` (`@free-react-templates/carouselbay`)

## Section Breakdown & Structure Order

1. **Navbar**: Sticky header with logo, navigation links, and action button.
2. **Hero Carousel**: Full-width or boxed slider with headings, descriptions, and CTA buttons.
3. **Features Section**: 3-column or 4-column feature grid with Lucide icons.
4. **Showcase Carousel**: Interactive carousel displaying featured projects/items.
5. **Testimonials Section**: Customer reviews carousel with avatars and ratings.
6. **CTA Banner**: Newsletter or action signup.
7. **Footer**: Navigation links, social icons, and mandatory Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Fidelity Checklist

- [ ] Tailwind v4 `@theme` tokens matching brand colors.
- [ ] Lucide icons for all UI items.
- [ ] Fully responsive mobile menu toggle.
- [ ] 100% test coverage (`npm run test:coverage`) across all components.
- [ ] CNAME file set to `carouselbay.free.componentdock.com`.
- [ ] Footer links to `https://www.componentdock.com/`.
